improvements_proposed.title: Add helmet middleware for HTTP security headers
improvements_proposed.scope: server/index.ts — add app.use(helmet({ contentSecurityPolicy: false })) after express.json()
improvements_proposed.expected_roi: HIGH — adds X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, HSTS headers automatically; prevents clickjacking and MIME sniffing; contentSecurityPolicy disabled to avoid breaking Vite-injected scripts
improvements_proposed.blocker_for_apply: Requires installing new dependency: npm install helmet. User approval needed before modifying package.json.
improvements_proposed.rationale: Express out-of-the-box sends no security headers. Helmet is the de-facto standard and costs zero runtime overhead. CSP should be disabled initially to avoid breaking the Vite SPA embed; can be tightened in a later cycle.

improvements_proposed.title: Add express-rate-limit on API endpoints — especially scraping routes
improvements_proposed.scope: server/index.ts — global limiter (100 req/min) + tighter limiter on /api/pesquisa/* and /api/consulta-processual (10 req/min)
improvements_proposed.expected_roi: HIGH — prevents abuse of expensive DataJud/ScraperAPI calls, protects SCRAPER_API_KEY quota, reduces risk of cascading failures under load
improvements_proposed.blocker_for_apply: Requires installing new dependency: npm install express-rate-limit. User approval needed.
improvements_proposed.rationale: Scraping endpoints invoke external APIs (DataJud, ScraperAPI) that have usage quotas and cost money per call. Without rate limiting, a single user or bot can exhaust the monthly quota. The fix is 10 lines of code with a new dependency.

improvements_proposed.title: Split server/routes.ts into domain-scoped route modules
improvements_proposed.scope: Create server/routes/ directory with: clientes.ts, equipe.ts, processos.ts, atividades.ts, documentos.ts, financeiro.ts, scraping.ts, dashboard.ts, acervo.ts, comunicacoes.ts, deadlines.ts. Keep server/routes.ts as a thin re-exporting index.
improvements_proposed.expected_roi: MEDIUM — improves maintainability, reduces merge conflicts, enables per-domain ownership; does not change any behaviour
improvements_proposed.blocker_for_apply: Large mechanical refactor (3609 lines). Must preserve exact endpoint signatures and middleware order. High blast radius if done carelessly. Recommend a dedicated cycle or background task.
improvements_proposed.rationale: The current single-file architecture has reached a size where navigation is impractical, co-location of unrelated concerns causes accidental coupling, and parallel development by multiple agents risks conflicts.

improvements_proposed.title: Configure vitest as test runner with initial route smoke-tests
improvements_proposed.scope: Install vitest + supertest; add vitest.config.ts; add server/routes.test.ts with GET /api/clientes, GET /api/processos, GET /api/equipe smoke tests
improvements_proposed.expected_roi: HIGH — enables all future PROMETHEUS APPLY_WITH_NEW_TEST fixes; catches regressions before they reach production; unblocks confidence-gated auto-apply
improvements_proposed.blocker_for_apply: Requires modifying package.json (add vitest, supertest, @vitest/coverage-v8). User approval needed. Also requires creating vitest.config.ts (allowed — not in forbidden list).
improvements_proposed.rationale: Without a test runner, PROMETHEUS can only apply behavior-neutral fixes. 70% of potential fixes (including security fixes with behavioral impact) are permanently stuck in DEFER. One afternoon of test setup unlocks future automation.

improvements_proposed.title: Add explicit CORS configuration with origin whitelist
improvements_proposed.expected_roi: LOW-MEDIUM — currently low risk since SPA and API share origin; becomes critical if API is ever accessed from a separate frontend or mobile app
improvements_proposed.blocker_for_apply: Requires installing cors package OR implementing manually. Low priority while SPA and API are co-hosted.
improvements_proposed.rationale: Explicit CORS configuration documents intent and prevents accidental cross-origin access if deployment topology changes (e.g., separate Replit deployment for the frontend).

improvements_proposed.title: Adopt structured logging (pino) — replace 31 console.error calls
improvements_proposed.scope: Install pino + pino-pretty; create server/logger.ts; replace console.error/warn/log throughout server/ with logger.error/warn/info including {requestId, path, method} context
improvements_proposed.expected_roi: MEDIUM — structured logs enable log aggregation (Datadog, CloudWatch, Loki), request tracing, and faster debugging in production; pino is 5× faster than console.log
improvements_proposed.blocker_for_apply: Requires installing pino and pino-pretty. Broad change touching 31+ call sites across server/routes.ts and other server files.
improvements_proposed.rationale: Console.error in production sends unstructured strings that are hard to filter, aggregate, or alert on. Structured logging is a prerequisite for observability tooling.
